CustomField.description: The exact API name of the field this integration reads or writes, for example Email, AnnualRevenue, or a custom field such as Legacy_Customer_Number__c. This value is stored as plain text rather than a metadata reference so that it works consistently across any org this package is installed in. Match this value exactly, including the __c suffix for custom fields, when looking up which integrations touch a given field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The API name of the field this integration reads or writes.
CustomField.label: Field API Name
